NONE: › in psychoanalysis, the deepest part of the unconscious mind that represents the most basic natural human needs and emotions such as hunger, anger, and the wish for pleasure
（精神分析中的）本我，伊德（指潛意識的最深層，代表人最基本的需要和情感）
› mainly US to look at a person or a body and say who that person is to someone in authority

U: A2 [ U ] informal abbreviation for identification: any official card or document with your name and photograph or other information on it that you use to prove who you are
身分證；身分證明文件（identification的縮寫）

NONE: › written abbreviation for the US state of Idaho: used in addresses
（美國）愛達荷州, 愛德荷州（寫地址時Idaho的縮寫）

example: Do you have any ID? A driving licence or cheque card will do.
你有身分證明文件嗎？駕照或支票卡都行。
He had to go to the morgue to ID the body.
他不得不去停屍間辨認屍體。
I'd just got in the bath when the phone rang.
我剛進浴缸電話就響了。
